youtube.title: Where was the first World Cup played? Most Europeans refused to go ⚽
youtube.description:
The five-time champions, the hosts of the second edition, or the third one? The first World Cup was played in a single city, in a stadium finished days after the opening match, by thirteen teams. Most of Europe stayed home; the few who came spent two weeks on a ship and picked up another squad on the way.
Which did you pick?
